Lena (Sales): Quick ask - Orbita wants a one-time customer acquisition discount to finish their pilot. Asking for $12,000 credit + 45-day payment terms during pilot. Need finance OK asap.
Tom (Finance): Amount? Is this a system error or negotiated concession?
Lena (Sales): Negotiated request tied to extra integration work they did. Not a billing error. They commit to convert to a 12-month ARR if KPIs met.
Priya (Account Ops): Commercial summary: 1) $12,000 one-off credit 2) Net45 for pilot invoices only 3) Conversion to ARR at milestone or no further concessions.
Tom (Finance): $12k under approval threshold for Finance Ops but requires written sfdc note + Legal clause limiting term. Need GL code and approver name.
Lena (Sales): GL: 6210 - Promotions. Approver: Tom (Finance).
Oscar (Legal): I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum: limited-term credit, Net45 for pilot invoices, explicit non-precedent language and covenant on conversion KPIs. Will send to Orbita counsel.
Tom (Finance): Approve contingent on signed addendum and update in salesforce opp with credit line.
Priya (Account Ops): SalesForce opp ID: 0045-ORB-PILOT. I'll add the credit schedule once doc is signed.
Lena (Sales): Sent doc to Orbita legal at 10:34.
billing-bot: Note: manual credit entries allowed after signed approval. Ticket TKT-4821 created.
Lena (Sales): Orbita signed at 15:08 and returned PDF link: https://drive.redwood/drive/pilot-orbita/credit-addendum.pdf
Tom (Finance): Received. Approving one-time credit $12,000 booked to GL 6210 as "pilot acquisition credit - Orbita". Will post approval in TKT-4821 and notify AR.
Priya (Account Ops): Noted. I'll schedule the credit on next billing run and set Net45 for pilot invoices only.
Lena (Sales): Thanks team. I'll track conversion and ensure KPI evidence lands in the opp.
Tom (Finance): Closing note: non-precedent, documented in SF opp 0045-ORB-PILOT.
Priya (Account Ops): Closing thread.
